notifications.intro: Get a reminder for scheduled medicine doses and when a nap window opens, even with the app closed.
notifications.guardrail: Reminders come from the prescriptions you entered. They can be late or missing (no connection, phone settings), so don't rely on them alone. Not medical advice.
notifications.syncedOnly: Reminders follow synced data: a dose logged offline stops reminders only after it syncs.
notifications.offline: Connect to the internet to change notification settings.

states.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications from Lotties.
states.iosNeedsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work after you add Lotties to your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there.
states.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. To allow them, open your browser or system settings, find this site and allow notifications, then come back here.

explainer.title: Turn on notifications?
explainer.kinds: Lotties can remind you of scheduled medicine doses and tell you when a nap window opens. You choose which reminders, for each baby.
explainer.lockScreen: The lock screen shows generic text, without baby or medicine names, unless you turn on Show names.
explainer.turnOff: You can turn them off anytime in Settings.

announce.on: Notifications are on for this device
announce.off: Notifications are off for this device
announce.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
announce.testFailed: The test couldn't be delivered. Turn notifications off and on again, then retry.
announce.subscribeFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications on this device. Try again.

reminders.heading: Reminders
reminders.viewerOnly: Only parents get reminders for this baby.
reminders.doseHelp: Scheduled doses only, never as-needed medicines.
reminders.napHelp: When the estimated nap window opens during the day.
reminders.bellyPainHelp: When belly pain often shows up around the same time, a note 30 min before.
reminders.overtiredHelp: When the baby has been awake nearly as long as usual, a note 15 min before.
reminders.fussyHelp: When fussiness often starts around the same time, a note 30 min before.
reminders.diaperWetHelp: When a wet diaper is usually due, a note 10 min before.
reminders.diaperDirtyHelp: When a dirty diaper usually comes, after a feed or from the usual gaps, a note shortly before.
reminders.appointmentsHelp: Before each appointment, at the times chosen for it.
reminders.vaccinesHelp: A note on the day a dose may be due, according to the schedule.
reminders.doctorHelp: When the doctor sends a prescription suggestion or a recommendation.

quiet.help: No nap reminders or belly pain heads-ups between these times.
quiet.sameTime: Start and end must be different times.
quiet.medicine: Also silence medicine reminders in quiet hours
quiet.medicineHelp: When off, medicine reminders still arrive at the times you scheduled.

names.switch: Show baby and medicine names on notifications
names.help: Anyone who can see your lock screen will see them. Dose amounts are never shown.

prompt.title: Get a reminder at the scheduled times?
prompt.body: Lotties can notify this device when a scheduled dose is not logged yet.

reminderLine.stopped: No more reminders for this dose.
reminderLine.offline: Connect to the internet to snooze.

notifications.whyLink: Remind me when the window opens
